purpose: Repeatable synthetic observations of capture, redeployment, recapture, and three passive skills on 12-versus-12 armies; timing has no pass/fail threshold.

config.random: 32-bit LCG: state = (1664525 * state + 1013904223) mod 2^32; random = state / 2^32
config.playerArmy: Unchanged initial 4 knights, 4 archers, 3 slimes plus king at all sampled floors; no reward-based optimization.

policies.wait-only: Player always waits. This is an intentionally passive control, not representative human play.
policies.mirrored-ai: Player uses chooseAI on a cloned state with current-side labels and both hand containers swapped; original-origin metadata is retained. No production behavior changes.

config.timingScope: chooseAI measures only original enemy decisions including attack prediction. act measures each original successful/attempted action including passive resolution. VM startup, mirrored-player decisions, rendering and animation excluded.
config.passives: Archer supportFire, knight inspiration and golem stoneWall use production rules on both sides. No skill strengths or AI scoring are tuned by this observation script.
config.passiveCounts: followUpHits counts attack events with followUp=true; guardActivations counts guard events for the attacking side. maxHitsPerAction includes the normal hit and its support hits.
config.progress: No-damage plies count consecutive successful actions without damage; a capture also deals damage.
config.captures: Count nonking capture events. recaptures are subsequent captures of the same battle ID. Kings are tracked separately as defeatedKings. Unique counts are per fight; deploymentHpRestored sums full HP created by deployment.
config.identityChecks: After every action check board/hands ID conservation, immutable type/origin/roster linkage, current allegiance/container consistency, king exclusion from hands, board cap, original ownership, and terminal reward/return sets.
config.reversal: A moving piece returns to its previous occupied square on its next move, regardless of intervening actors. The observation baseline resets after deployment.
config.repeatedLayout: Side-to-move plus board and hand individual state repeated; excludes AI history, so repetition alone is not a proven cycle.

limitations: Synthetic Node simulations do not establish human difficulty, overall balance, animation feel, or iPhone performance.
Clock timing, generatedAt, and environment vary between machines and runs; fixed seeds reproduce compositions and actions for the same engine.
Floors 1, 5 and 10 sample only three seeds and two fixed player policies. Floor 1 has a fixed enemy army, so its seeds repeat the same logical fight.
Observed waiting, reversals, or action-cap endings are reported without tuning AI, turn timing, passive strengths, capture/redeployment rules, combat, or encounter weights.
